author: RedReindeer3932
text:
I just had three replacements sent to me (three sensors within 2 or so weeks). Did it online. I use my phone to read data. It shows the last three sensor s/n’s (needed to fill in the info).  Mine fell off as soon as I started getting a bit sweaty during work.  THREE did this.  They replaced without any issues. I assume they can read the data online from the serial numbers of each individual device to verify before they stopped working.  Recommend doing it online.

Most medical things need to be stored at reasonable temperatures. Recommend applying in coolness of your house, then those two recommendations are met, if weather temps an issue.  However, after application, can’t control temperatures in everyday environment that your body is exposed to.
